ZMB.note: The directives cite the Bank's oversight mandate but do not say it licenses providers or oversees a switch.

facts.fact: The Bank of Zambia's Prohibition against Unwarranted Charges and Fees on Electronic Money Services Directives, 2024, in force on Gazette publication on 2 August 2024, ban listed e-money wallet fees and cap others, with an offence and fine for breach.
facts.system: Prohibition against Unwarranted Charges and Fees on Electronic Money Services Directives, 2024

ZMB.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Bank of Zambia's 2024 e-money charges directives, issued under the National Payment Systems Act 2007 and the Bank of Zambia Act 2022 and binding on all e-money institutions, banks and financial institutions from 2 August 2024, set prohibited and capped e-money fees.
facts.system: Prohibition against Unwarranted Charges and Fees on Electronic Money Services Directives, 2024

facts.fact: The Bank of Zambia's directives of 2 August 2024 regulate fees on e-money wallets in operation, including deposits, cash-out, merchant and bill payments.
The Bank of Zambia's directives of 2 August 2024 cap fees for cross-network transfers through the NFS and for wallet-to-bank and bank-to-wallet transfers.

ZMB.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment to the state.
